meta.notes: Built in, from public knowledge; still to be checked on real samples. Keep's reminders: category reminder, the note's title as the title, its first words as the text, the reminder's time as when. The same shape as tasks-reminder. The category isn't relied on (reminder when set): share notices, sync and system ones are left out. Within the hour the time reads "5 min ago". Each reminder up is one face; the count is a flip.
